Name: FruitTeaShake
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
About This Mod
[b]Fruit Tea Shake[/b] adds a complete fruit tea crafting and shaking system to Stardew Valley. From juicing and brewing to an interactive shaking mini-game, craft your own signature hand-shaken fruit tea!
[line]
Features
🍹 Juice Making
Place fresh fruits into the [b]Juicer[/b] to produce fresh juice in [b]60 in-game minutes[/b].

[th]Value[/th]
[/tr]

[/tr]

[td]50g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Energy[/td]
[td]+10[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]☕ Green Tea Brewing
Use the [b]Tea Infuser[/b] to brew tea leaves into green tea in [b]30 in-game minutes[/b].
🍵 Fruit Tea Brewing
Mix juice with green tea in the [b]Blender[/b] for [b]120 in-game minutes[/b].

[th]Value[/th]
[/tr]

[/tr]

[td]+15[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]🔧 Crafting Recipes

[/table]🎯 Shake It Up!
Hold a fruit tea and hold left-click for 3 seconds:
[list]
[*]Character performs shaking animation with the tea[/*]
[*]After 3 seconds, tea is tossed up and enters a judgment mini-game[/*]
[*]Complete 3 judgment rounds to increase shake level[/*]
[/list]✨ Shake Level System

[/tr]

[/tr]
[/table][quote]Shaken teas are always treated as "Loved" gifts (80 base value) when gifted, with extra bonuses added on top.[/quote][line]
Processing Flow
text
Fruit ──[Juicer 60min]──→ Juice
                              │
Tea Leaves ──[Tea Infuser 30min]──→ Green Tea ──┼──[Blender 120min]──→ Fruit Tea
                              │
                              └──[Shake 3sec]──→ Shaken Tea (Level 1~3)

[line]
Notes
[list]
[*]Must hold a [b]single[/b], [b]unshaken[/b] fruit tea to start shaking[/*]
[*]Already-shaken teas cannot be shaken again[/*]
[*]Shaken teas cannot stack[/*]
[/list]模组简介
[b]果茶摇[/b] 为星露谷物语添加了一套完整的果茶制作与摇动玩法系统。从榨汁、煮茶到趣味摇动，让你亲手调制出独一无二的手摇果茶！
[line]
核心功能
🍹 果汁制作
将新鲜水果放入 [b]榨汁机[/b]，等待 [b]60 游戏分钟[/b] 即可获得鲜榨果汁。

[/tr]
[/table]☕ 绿茶煮制
使用 [b]煮茶机[/b] 将茶叶煮成绿茶，[b]30 游戏分钟[/b] 即可完成。
🍵 果茶调制
将果汁与绿茶放入 [b]搅拌机[/b]，[b]120 游戏分钟[/b] 混合成果茶。

加工流程示意
text
水果 ──[榨汁机 60分钟]──→ 果汁
                              │

                              │
                              └──[摇一摇 3秒]──→ 重摇果茶（1~3重）

[*]已摇过的果茶无法再次摇动[/*]
[*]重摇果茶不可堆叠[/*]
[/list]
